headline: TBR @ BAL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TBR 4.65 at BAL 2.80, with a projected total of 7.45. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TBR: TBR moved -0.14 runs while BAL moved -0.87, changing the projected margin by +0.73 runs. The projected total fell -1.01, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +19.4%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Shane McClanahan has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 0.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Junior Caminero, Yandy Díaz, Cedric Mullins, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Tyler O'Neill, Blaze Alexander because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
